entries.t: <FACE:08>Sooo hooot!<NL>What is this heat!<WAIT><FACE:06>Even if it's to test<NL>Medabots…<WAIT>Recreating the desert<NL>heat just as it is!
<FACE:05><PLAYER>!<NL><WAIT>No one could be out<NL>in a place like this<WAIT>Let's check quick and<NL>move on!
<FACE:01>…If she helped out<NL>we'd finish sooner…<WAIT><FACE:06>You said something?
<FACE:03>N-nope, nothing!
<FACE:14>Hoooold it!<NL><WAIT>Heh heh heh… <PLAYER><NL>No further for you!<WAIT><FACE:19>We're takin' this<NL>place, we are!
<FACE:05>You two… why are you<NL>in a spot this hot?
<FACE:1A>S-shut it, you!<NL>We like this heat!
<FACE:14>That's right!<NL><WAIT>A real man can't lose<NL>to nature's worst!
<FACE:07>Oh, sorry!<NL>I thought you'd been<WAIT>shut out, and this was<NL>the only place left!
<FACE:15>S-shut your mouth!<NL><WAIT>Gutless lot like that,<NL>we don't want 'em!<WAIT>What's so great about<NL>running in a pack?
<FACE:0A>Hmm, with folks like<NL>this, order's hard…
<FACE:14>Eh? Don't know that<NL>face, do I?<WAIT><FACE:19>And who might he be?
<FACE:00>Ah… he's Fubu…
<FACE:0D>I came to visit like<NL>you and got caught up<WAIT><FACE:0A>Right now I'm with<NL>this <PLAYER>…<WAIT>You lot should help<NL>him out too
<FACE:15>An outsider, huh!<NL><WAIT>If you want our help,<NL>try beating us first!
<FACE:1B>All talk! A coward who<NL>can't even Robattle!
<FACE:0B>Hmph… after all that,<NL>I've gotta fight now…
<FACE:0A>All right, <PLAYER><NL>You'll help, right!
<FACE:0A>Hmph, good Medabots,<NL>but zero teamwork<WAIT>One of you must lead<NL>and pull the team…<WAIT>In a team Robattle,<NL>don't fight scattered
<FACE:14>…<WAIT><FACE:1D>…<WAIT><FACE:0B>Hm? What is it?<NL>Another match?
<FACE:19>We underestimated you!<NL><WAIT>We felt keenly that we<NL>needed a leader too!
<FACE:18>We…<NL><WAIT>We've been camped in<NL>this manly spot<WAIT>looking for someone<NL>worthy to be leader!
<FACE:14>You're the one! Our<NL>leader!<WAIT>Won't you be our…<NL>our leader?
<FACE:0D>H-hey! Cut it out!
<FACE:14>Won't let go!<NL>Won't let go, leader!<WAIT><FACE:19>I-I'll follow you<NL>anywhere, I will!
<FACE:0D>Gyah… hey<NL><WAIT><FACE:0B>Hey, stop it!<NL>That's gross!<WAIT><FACE:14>What're you sayin'?<NL>It's manly bonding!
<FACE:04>Hiyori… that sound,<NL>don't tell me…<WAIT><FACE:05>Knew there'd be a<NL>catch… Fubuki's out
<FACE:0D>Look what you did! I<NL>missed the Robattle!<WAIT><FACE:07>It's fine, Fubuki<NL>You make a nice pair
<FACE:16>Hiyori says the<NL>smartest things!
<FACE:0D>Argh, enough!<NL>Do what you want!
<FACE:05>It's so hot…<NL>Can't we fix this?
<FACE:0A>No helping it. Blocks<NL>like this are needed
<FACE:0A>Won't this heat get<NL>to the Medabots too?
<FACE:00>Gotta check what's<NL>around here
<FACE:19>Mizore joined the<NL>team!<NL><WAIT><FACE:14>Gousetsu joined the<NL>team!
